title: Burke & Herbert Financial Services Corp. 8-K Filing — Q1 2026 Earnings and Dividend
summary: Burke & Herbert Financial Services Corp. (BHRB), a small regional bank headquartered in Alexandria, Virginia, filed an 8-K on April 23, 2026, announcing Q1 2026 earnings results and declaring a quarterly cash dividend of $0.55 per share payable June 1, 2026 to shareholders of record May 15, 2026. The filing contains standard corporate disclosures with no discussion of macro conditions or market structure.
